data.name: apollographql/apollo-client-devtools
data.enhanced_text:
Apollo Client browser developer tools.

### Install local version
If you want to install a local version of the extension instead, skip ahead to the Developing section.

## Installation
Chrome users can install the extension by visiting the Chrome Web Store.
Opera users can install the extension from Chrome Web Store using the Download Chrome Extension addon for Opera.
Firefox users can install the addon via Firefox Browser Add-ons.

data.name: andrewnguonly/Lumos
data.enhanced_text:
A RAG LLM co-pilot for browsing the web, powered by local LLMs.

This Chrome extension is powered by Ollama. Inference is done on your local machine without any _remote_ server support. However, due to security constraints in the Chrome extension platform, the app does rely on _local_ server support to run the LLM. This app is inspired by the Chrome extension example provided by the Web LLM project and the local LLM examples provided by LangChain.
- Summarize long threads on issue tracking sites, forums, and social media sites.
- Ask questions about reviews on business and product pages.
- Ask questions about long, technical documentation.
